verdict.rationale: Omarchy provides a guided install flow (write ISO, answer five questions, get a finished desktop), a full manual covering keyboard shortcuts, theming, terminal/editor setup, dual-boot, and more, which serves as onboarding for switchers, and community testimonials confirm the install is uncomplicated and works well for newcomers coming from other distros. missing for 10: a dedicated step-by-step 'desktop interface tour' tutorial for absolute switchers (vs. reference manual), and independent verification that new-to-Linux users successfully complete onboarding without prior Arch/Hyprland knowledge.
